title: Only boy implies John is a boy
premises: always [P:p]: always [x:e]: only(predicate: P, entity: x) -> (apply(predicate: P, entity: x) ∧ always [y:e]: apply(predicate: P, entity: y) -> equals(left: y, right: x))

proof.formula: always [P:p]: always [x:e]: only(predicate: P, entity: x) -> (apply(predicate: P, entity: x) ∧ always [y:e]: apply(predicate: P, entity: y) -> equals(left: y, right: x))
always [x:e]: only(predicate: boy, entity: x) -> (apply(predicate: boy, entity: x) ∧ always [y:e]: apply(predicate: boy, entity: y) -> equals(left: y, right: x))
only(predicate: boy, entity: john) -> (apply(predicate: boy, entity: john) ∧ always [y:e]: apply(predicate: boy, entity: y) -> equals(left: y, right: john))
apply(predicate: boy, entity: john) ∧ always [y:e]: apply(predicate: boy, entity: y) -> equals(left: y, right: john)
